name: Content Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with teal wool
body: News, events, team members, jobs and copy changes, written in your house style. If it doesn't know something, like a photo credit, it asks instead of guessing.

name: QA Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with mustard yellow wool
body: Checks every change before you see it: broken links, page speed, accessibility, the phone layout, and a before and after comparison so nothing else moved.

name: Design & Build Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with burnt orange wool
body: New sections and landing pages built from your existing components, plus booking widgets, video and forms. Anything involving code goes to Toby before it goes live.

name: SEO Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with pink wool
body: Page titles, descriptions, alt text and internal links, with a monthly report on how you show up in Google.

name: Tracking Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with purple wool
body: Analytics, conversion tracking and cookie consent, set up properly. Every tracking change goes to Toby first.
